conditional_relaxed_dag.definition: Use the stage-substep serial service demands but allow legally separate warp work to overlap; relax shared-resource arbitration, then max with summed resource capacity budgets. This is a floor under stated demand assumptions, never a completed hardware schedule.
conditional_relaxed_dag.formula: max(globalHBMfloor,2604+L*2928+747,full summed resource budgets); response/sync/SFU unknowns enter max-plus predecessor equations
conditional_relaxed_dag.legal_overlap: S publish→KS/QS while CG1 decays S and expands gates; QS can overlap residual; NV can overlap QS_scale; dS can overlap O_stage; warp8/CG0 can run ahead within rings; actual resource contention may serialize them.
conditional_relaxed_dag.required_resource_sums: Per block common tensor source packet service1224cy(aggregate capacityfloor1220), TMEMcopy768cy, SMEM source requests1808cy(2576if MMAfeed charged), CVT960cy, scalar packet645cy(aggregate capacityfloor644), HBMpacket2796cy(aggregate capacityfloor2795). Same-resource consumers share one calendar.
conditional_relaxed_dag.full_legal_contended_makespan: Conditional attained synthetic resource calendar is in k4_calendar_L16/L32/L64.json. It is legal for the source-DAG/coarse service assumptions, not an exact hardware prediction.

primary_packet_resource_calendar.kind: conditional conservative source-service packet resource calendar
primary_packet_resource_calendar.formula: S_j=MAX(all predecessor F, previous same-resource F); F_j=S_j+CEILING(work/rate,1)
primary_packet_resource_calendar.policy: earliest eligible service start, zero-cost events before positive work, then earliest dependency-ready time, then stable declaration order
primary_packet_resource_calendar.TMA_packet: G2S loads:HBMread thenSMEMwrite. S2G outputstore:SMEMread thenHBMwrite. Completion/wait and slot release follow all packet service; source transfer direction preserved.
primary_packet_resource_calendar.unknowns: zero only ideal numeric service; symbolic fields retained at every task
primary_packet_resource_calendar.tensor_operand_feed: covered in peak tensor service, separately exposed as shared-copy-port sensitivity
primary_packet_resource_calendar.gate_demand: source lane-request conservative case; hypothetical per-warp broadcast/CSE reuse sensitivity
primary_packet_resource_calendar.terminal_evidence: untimed clean SASS terminal region PC0x9510–0x95e0 has only barrier wait/release, no LDTM; unused reads present in PTX removed by ptxas
primary_packet_resource_calendar.correction_reason: Correct output physical causal dependency independent of any timing; v1 outputHBM→SMEM ordering superseded.

joins_and_backpressure: Q/K TMA slots released by BOTH warp8 andwarp10; Q's two slots wait for QS, K's three slots wait for dS.
CG0 must commit Ainv then materialize QK before touching next block T; QK consumer wait can therefore backpressure T ring2 and the single TMA producer.
CG1 shared accumulator has1 slot: NV acquisition waits KS read release; next KS waits prior NV read release.
QS/O has1 slot: Ointra waits QS in-place scaling/release, next QS waits final O staging/release.
S accumulator has1 slot: dS waits decayed state release, next CG1 S read waits dS completion and previous O staging.
Gate producer ring5 preserves4-block lookahead. Reuse gate_i waits BOTH CG0 andCG1 consumers; warp11 gate_(i+4) is before blocking Ostore_i.
O ring2 reuse waits actual TMA store completion; warp11 cannot overlap different O stores because wait_group0 is inside each call.
Fixed input0 VKS→NV overwrite andinput1 Delta reuse rely on accumulator completion proofs, not explicit empty-stage acquire.
NV andDelta full-tile commits join after the entire interleaved store loop, so no source-level per-subtile O/dS pipeline.
limitations: Source-only declared instruction shapes and copy atoms are not SASS inspection. No claim of exact hardware instruction issue latency.
SMEM lane-request bytes and source SFU invocations can shrink after compiler CSE and shared broadcast. Preserve this as sensitivity, not hard physical transfer count.
Last-CP syntactic state reads were removed in the clean untimed compiled SASS; primary theta_terminal_read=0. Source and standalone store-enabled path remain distinct.
Descriptor workspace512 used bytes/CTA reserved640 is not an exact descriptor write/read traffic ledger. Setup/fence/control remains symbolic.
Peak FP32 rate75e12 is distinct from the explicitly approved128scalarops/cycle scenario; the latter is used only as model assumption.
